triggers.question: Is MAE persistently elevated when the quarterback is uncertain or changed?
triggers.threshold: MAE gap > 2 SE, n ≥ 30 in each group

triggers.question: Does EdgeDesk persistently over-project its favourite?
Is there a conference-specific residual bias?
triggers.threshold: a home conference with n ≥ 30 and |mean residual| > 2 SE

triggers.question: Are verified major disagreements failing systematically?
triggers.threshold: n ≥ 20 settled verified and the market moved toward EdgeDesk < 50% of the time

triggers.question: Has probability calibration or interval coverage drifted?
triggers.threshold: last-100 win ECE > 0.06, or 80% coverage outside 75–85%

triggers.question: Has closing-line value deteriorated?
triggers.threshold: last-50 mean CLV < 0 by more than 2 SE, n ≥ 50

triggers.question: Is large rating-state divergence linked to model error (historical walk-forward)?
triggers.threshold: holdout LARGE − LOW MAE difference, and a football-only correction clearing the 0.05 bar

triggers.question: Is the live MAE above the holdout reference?

triggers.rule: A trigger opens research only when its threshold and minimum sample are both met. One ugly game never does. A fired trigger opens a research candidate; it never edits a model.

open.title: Large current-rating vs pricing-state divergence predicts margin error; a football-only blend of the divergence improves walk-forward MAE
